carry_forward.root_cause_lead: TRACED, not guessed. Ignition is NOT in runHostTick — grep for runDefenderIgnition over src/ shows it is called ONLY from runGodlyMatcherCore (godlyMatcherCore.ts:62 runSpawnerIgnition, :64 runDefenderIgnition), and that function opens with `if (!world.isHost) return null;`.
